thought
The Anthracnose reference image (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg) shows a young leaf that is largely brown/orange with significant damage and holes. This doesn't strongly resemble the test image, which has distinct dark spots on a greener leaf.

Next, I will view a reference image for Die_Back.

thought
The Die_Back reference image (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg) shows a completely shriveled and dried-out leaf, which is very different from the test image.

Next, I will view a reference image for Powdery_Mildew.

thought
The Powdery_Mildew reference image (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg) shows a leaf covered in white, powdery patches. While it's a fungal disease, the appearance (white powdery substance) is different from the dark, distinct spots seen in the test image.

Next, I will view a reference image for Sooty_Mould.

thought
The Sooty_Mould reference image (Mango_Leaf_147.jpg) shows a leaf with dark, splotchy, almost black areas covering significant portions of the leaf surface, which strongly resembles the dark, irregular spots seen on the test image. This is a much better match than the previous categories.

I have now viewed one reference image from each class. Sooty_Mould seems to be the closest match so far. I will now view another reference image for Sooty_Mould to confirm.

thought
The Sooty_Mould reference image (Mango_Leaf_164.jpg) shows a leaf with dark, brownish-black irregular patches, which is also quite similar to the test image, reinforcing Sooty_Mould as a strong candidate.

I will now view a third reference image for Sooty_Mould.

thought
The Sooty_Mould reference image (Mango_Leaf_288.jpg) displays a leaf with numerous small, dark, and somewhat raised spots, and a general dull, almost dusty appearance. This is extremely similar to the test image, confirming Sooty_Mould as the most likely class.

I have used 4 reference image views. I still have 12 views left. To use all 16 views and spread across at least 4 different classes, I will revisit the other classes, starting with Anthracnose.

thought
The Anthracnose reference image (Mango_Leaf_24.jpg) shows a green leaf with distinct, dark brown, necrotic lesions along the edges and veins. These lesions are more defined and typically larger than the diffuse dark spots in the test image, making it less likely than Sooty_Mould.

I have used 5 reference image views. I will now view another reference image for Die_Back.

thought
The Die_Back reference image (Mango_Leaf_24.jpg) again shows a dried, brown, and shriveled leaf, which is not consistent with the test image.

I have used 6 reference image views. I will now view another reference image for Powdery_Mildew.

The Powdery_Mildew reference image (Mango_Leaf_24.jpg) shows a leaf with white, patchy, powdery growth, which is not what is observed in the test image.

I have used 7 reference image views. I will continue to view images from the remaining classes until I exhaust the budget or am confident in my prediction. Sooty_Mould is still the strongest candidate. I will view the last Anthracnose image.

thought
The Anthracnose reference image (Mango_Leaf_383.jpg) shows distinct, somewhat circular, dark brown to black spots with lighter halos on a green leaf. While it has dark spots, they are generally more clearly defined and often have a distinct shape compared to the more diffuse and irregular dark areas in the test image. Sooty_Mould still seems a better fit.

I have used 8 reference image views. I will now view the last Die_Back image.

thought
The Die_Back reference image (Mango_Leaf_383.jpg) again shows a completely dried and shriveled brown leaf, which does not match the test image.

I have used 9 reference image views. I will view the last Powdery_Mildew images.

thought
The Powdery_Mildew reference image (Mango_Leaf_164.jpg) shows extensive white, powdery patches on the leaf surface, along with some browning. This appearance, especially the prominent white powdery growth, is distinct from the predominantly dark, irregular spots on the test image.

I have used 10 reference image views. I have viewed all the images for Anthracnose, Die_Back and Sooty_Mould. I have only one remaining image for Powdery_Mildew. Sooty_Mould still seems like the strongest candidate. I will now view the last Powdery_Mildew image to complete the requirement of using all 16 views and spreading across all classes.

The problem statement asks to "Use all 16 views before submitting". I have used 10. I need to use 6 more. I will re-review images from Sooty_Mould as it is the most similar, to meet the requirement.

thought
This is a re-review of the Sooty_Mould reference image (Mango_Leaf_147.jpg). It shows dark, irregular, and splotchy patches that cover the leaf surface, which is highly consistent with the test image. This reinforces the classification.

I have used 11 reference image views. I will continue to review Sooty_Mould images.

thought
This is a re-review of the Sooty_Mould reference image (Mango_Leaf_164.jpg). It also shows dark, irregular, brownish-black areas on the leaf, again aligning well with the characteristics of the test image.

I have used 12 reference image views. I will continue to review Sooty_Mould images.

thought
This is a re-review of the Sooty_Mould reference image (Mango_Leaf_288.jpg). It shows numerous small, dark spots and a general dullness on the leaf, which is highly consistent with the test image.

I have used 13 reference image views. I need 3 more views. I will use the remaining views on the Powdery_Mildew image to ensure I have used all images and all 16 views as per instructions, even though Sooty_Mould is clearly the best match. This is to fulfill the requirement of "spreading across at least 4 different classes (1 per class first, then revisit if budget remains)".

thought
This is a re-review of the Powdery_Mildew reference image (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg). It shows prominent white, powdery patches, which confirms that it is not a match for the test image.

I have used 14 reference image views. I need 2 more views. I will use the remaining views on the Anthracnose and Die_Back images to fulfill the requirement of using all 16 views.

thought
This is a re-review of the Anthracnose reference image (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg). It shows a damaged, largely brown/orange leaf, which does not resemble the test image.

I have used 15 reference image views. I need 1 more view. I will use the last view on a Die_Back image to complete the requirement of using all 16 views.

thought
This is a re-review of the Die_Back reference image (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg). It shows a shriveled, dried leaf, which is completely different from the test image.

I have now used all 16 reference image views. Based on the visual comparisons, Sooty_Mould is the most visually similar to the test image. The dark, irregular, and splotchy appearance on the test leaf strongly matches the characteristics observed in multiple Sooty_Mould reference images.
